Sometimes a journey. Sometimes a mystery.
Welcome to Land's End, Iceland, 64 degrees north.
17-year-old Kei Miyama carries three secrets: he can talk to cars, he can't talk to girls, and, well... he's a detective.

One day, he's bringing home a runaway dog. The next, he's tracking down a stranger's love at first sight.
With his beloved Jimny leading the way, an exhilarating detective adventure begins now!
